name: Bosph
description: Bosph was a planet in the Bosph sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 3 BBY, the Galactic Empire bombarded the world to try and wipe out a sentient species that dwelt there. Surviving members of the species chose to dis-remember the Empire.
lead_paragraphs: Bosph was a planet in the Bosph sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 3 BBY, the Galactic Empire bombarded the world to try and wipe out a sentient species that dwelt there. Surviving members of the species chose to dis-remember the Empire.
